name: Mars Hot Chicken
imageAlt: Mars Hot Chicken website shown on a desktop display
body: Located in the heart of one of Fort Lauderdale’s busiest tourist hubs — right across from the beach at 3146 NE 9th St — Mars Hot Chicken needed a professional website fast. With high foot traffic, a prime location, and growing buzz around their food, they couldn’t afford to wait.

Thanks to our Florida office based in Tampa, we were able to jump in immediately and deliver a fully custom website in just 48 hours. The site captures the bold flavor and energy of their brand, complete with crave-worthy menu visuals, strong calls to action, and seamless mobile ordering.
Now, whether it’s hungry tourists passing by or locals discovering them online, Mars Hot Chicken is ready to serve — with a digital presence as hot as their chicken.
result: Immediately people could order online, which increased their sales by 27% in the first week.
